```{r}
library(tidyverse)
data(ChickWeight)
```


## Introduction

Using an easy dataset to get used to updating quarto website on github pages

## Data exploration

```{r}
summary(ChickWeight)
```

There we go

```{r}
summary(ChickWeight) %>% 
    DT::datatable()
```

I know it doesn't look great just testing the site for changes

```{r}
ggplot(data = ChickWeight, 
       aes(x = Time, y = weight, color = Diet)) +
    
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
    
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Chick Growth Over Time by Diet",
       x = "Time (days)",
       y = "Weight (grams)")

```
